label: Open-site sweep: hypnosis / mind control (TMDB, MyDramaList, Wikipedia, TV Tropes)
description: Titles found by sweeping open sites (TMDB keyword pages for hypnosis, hypnotist, hypnotism, brainwashing, mind control; MyDramaList 'Hypnosis' and 'Pregnancy' tags; Wikipedia hypnosis / mind-control categories; TV Tropes hypnosis pages) after dramaexpress.net turned out to be behind a bot check. Adult women only, no minors in a sexual or hypnosis context, no pornography. Every new record has a verified free legal link in sources/watch-links.json. Everything else the sweep found was already in the catalog, or lacked a verified free link, and is listed in dropped.

records.title: Evil Lurks
records.mechanism: Hypnotherapy (a hypnotherapist possessed by an entity, the "Shh Man", hypnotizes a grieving woman in a private session)
records.summary: Grieving Kimberly joins a hypnotherapy group and is singled out by the hypnotist Harold, who is possessed by the "Shh Man". He puts her under hypnosis in a private session and assaults her; she is committed to a psychiatric hospital and gives birth to a daughter, Erica. Fifteen years later, at the next blood moon, the entity returns for its offspring. Non-graphic note: the assault is implied and the film's focus is Kimberly's trauma and protecting Erica.
records.character: Kimberly (Amanda Winston), a grieving adult woman, and the hypnotist Harold (Chris Shern); daughter Erica (Savannah Mae) is a child of the assault and is not hypnotized or shown in any sexual context
records.provenance: Open-sites sweep (TMDB keyword pages: hypnosis, hypnotist, hypnotism, brainwashed, mind control, ...; MyDramaList tags; Wikipedia categories; TV Tropes), 1 Oct 2026 PT; adult woman, non-graphic wording
records.note: Possession-framed hypnosis (the hypnotist is possessed), so tagged occult as well; indie horror.
records.pregnant_end_note: Kimberly gives birth to Erica in the psychiatric hospital after the assault (birth)
